mainEntity.name: How long does it take to construct an in-law addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Construction timelines for an in-law suite vary based on whether you are remodeling existing interior square footage or building a brand-new detached or attached structure. Interior remodels and garage conversions generally take less time because the exterior shell and roof are already in place. Ground-up additions take longer due to site preparation, foundation pours, framing, exterior roofing, siding or stucco, and multiple municipal inspection stages. Material procurement, weather conditions during exterior phases, and the complexity of bathroom plumbing also influence total project duration. Clear communication throughout construction helps keep milestones on schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Timelines vary from a few months for interior conversions to longer schedules for ground-up additions that require foundation work, exterior framing, and multi-stage inspections.
